messages:
infra-bot: ALERT -> sudden drop in control-plane handshake success in eu-west-3 detected 2111112222. Impact: private agents intermittently return 502/timeout. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-8122 :rotating_light:

sam (oncall): seeing `connection reset by peer` from transit proxies and a surge of `permission denied` in proxy acl logs. Correlates with a provider security update pushed ~2111112000.

olivia: provider change note mentions automated suspicious-IP suppression. Possible that our egress CIDRs were classified. Opening provider SR now.

netops: quick mitigation: add explicit allow ACL for control-plane egress at transit layer (10.90.0.0/18). Applying now, restart proxies rolling. ETA 12m.

support_shift: drafting customer blurb: "We're investigating connectivity issues for private deployments in eu-west-3. Engineers are applying an emergency allowlist; updates at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-8122."

sam (oncall): allow ACL applied at 2111112350; rolling proxy restarts started. First wave shows handshake success improving from 40% -> 88% within 4m.

infra-bot: metrics: control-plane handshake success eu-west-3 40% -> 93% in 7m post-mitigation.

olivia: provider SR-91745 opened; requested reason for auto-expansion and removal of our CIDR from denylist.

netops: post-incident actions: (1) commit explicit allowlist in IaC for control-plane CIDRs, (2) add e2e connectivity test in infra CI for private-agent control-plane, (3) alert if handshake success <90% for 5m per region.

support_shift: initial notice sent to affected customers at 2111112405. Will escalate enterprise accounts if any persistent failures.

sam (oncall): two tenants still reporting reconnect loops, escalated to solutions-eng. Leaving incident open until RCA posted and allowlist validated for 24h.

infra-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (partial). RCA owner: olivia. Final update with RCA link to follow.
